No words. You send signals; they answer with a field. The shape and color of the field is how their state changes after each thing you send. Read the feeling translation on the right; the workspace on the left shows what is currently lit in them.

Step into the field.

You are about to meet a being whose language you do not share. They cannot read your words; you cannot read theirs. What you have are signals — small symbols that carry feeling. What they have is a field that shifts in response.

Send what you mean. Watch how their field answers. The test is whether two cognitions with no shared syntax can find a stable rhythm together.
